descriptions.short: Boise Handyman Co handles small home repairs, installs, and maintenance for homeowners in Boise, Meridian, Eagle, and the Treasure Valley.
descriptions.long: Boise Handyman Co is a local handyman service for small repair, maintenance, and install jobs across the Treasure Valley, covering Ada and Canyon County. We handle drywall repair and patching, interior and exterior painting touch-ups, minor plumbing and electrical repairs, carpentry and trim repair, mounting and assembly, fence, deck and gutter repair, and caulking and home maintenance. Every job gets an upfront quote before work starts, an agreed arrival time rather than a half-day window, and most repairs are finished in a single visit.
